correctness.rationale: Exact term induction identifies modal atoms with equality classes of forward itineraries; separate implications prove the cycle primitivity/unique-necklace and immediate-fiber injectivity criterion. Möbius inversion and disjoint noncycle predecessor fibers produce the independent product formula, and feasibility of each factor gives the rank. Color-refinement adds a class every nonstationary step, proving the sharp n-s depth bound. Verified 196579 exhaustive small colorings, 7402 graph/parameter counts and 26122 direct term closures, plus random and rank tests. Infinite generality of finite n is based on the proof, not computation.

value.rationale: Finite functional modal powersets are a natural class whose generating tuples measure state observability. The result gives an exact general census for all directed functional graphs, separates periodic necklaces from local fiber-injective assignments, and derives a usable sharp minimum generator rank and modal-depth bound with an extremal witness. These full structural invariants are materially stronger than a finite lookup or a mere restatement of trace separation.
